ai-foundry.note: Preferred over standalone openai for new templates. Includes AI Services + Project + Connections.

openai.note: Standalone Azure OpenAI (kind: OpenAI). Use ai-foundry instead for Foundry-based templates.

storage.note: Bundled inside ai-foundry module when using Foundry. Add separately for standalone blob scenarios.

keyvault.note: Only include when explicit secret storage is needed. Many templates use Managed Identity only.

container-registry.note: Required when using Container Apps with docker remoteBuild. Bundled in container-apps module.

scenarioNotes.rag-chatbot: ai-foundry module handles storage internally; ai-search is conditional (useSearchService flag)
scenarioNotes.multi-agent: ai-foundry includes storage + models; add cosmos-db if conversation history needed
scenarioNotes.api-backend: Add cosmos-db or storage depending on persistence needs
scenarioNotes.full-stack-app: Frontend served from Static Web App or bundled in Container App
scenarioNotes.data-pipeline: No container apps needed — uses batch processing or Functions
scenarioNotes.simple-chat: Minimal template — just AI + hosting + monitoring
